text: i have open prs on treams-rs to improve CI time (and associated local worktrees). have a look at them. if you think they look good, let’s get them merged, and also feel free to further improve if you see a way

items.html:
Merged PR #2, the only open PR. No review blockers.

  • Pushed an extra improvement: Intel Python 3.15 setup dropped 112 → 6 seconds. Final CI took 12.2 minutes, versus the earlier 19-minute median.
  • Verified just ci, just check-wheel, and all hosted PR checks.
  • Updated the PR description; posted no comments.
  • Updated local main and removed the branch/worktree, freeing roughly 4 GB.

Post-merge CI has started but hasn’t finished yet.

shas: ci: streamline Python and Intel smoke setup

items.html:
No. These changes improve CI and how future wheels are built; they don’t introduce a user-facing fix or feature.

I’d leave them on main for the next normal release, without a version bump now. That release will still run the uncached builds and Intel installation checks.
